name: 🚀 System Checker 😎🔥 on: push: branches: ["slimy"] pull_request: branches: ["slimy"] workflow_dispatch: concurrency: group: "ultra-deluxe" cancel-in-progress: false jobs: # ================================== # 🧪 JOB 1 — MULTI-OS PROJECT AUDIT # ================================== audit: name: 🧪 Audit & File Scan (${{ matrix.os }}) runs-on: ubuntu-latest strategy: matrix: os: [ubuntu-latest] steps: - name: 📥 Checkout Repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: 📂 List Files (Recursive) run: | echo "===== FILE LIST =====" ls -R - name: 🌳 Tree View + Save to File shell: bash run: | if command -v tree; then tree -a | tee tree.txt else echo "tree not installed, using ls" | tee tree.txt ls -R | tee -a tree.txt fi - name: 🧾 Root Summary run: | pwd ls -lah - name: 🧠 System & Hardware Info shell: bash run: | uname -a || ver echo "CPU Info:" lscpu || echo "Windows CPU info skipped" - name: 🛡️ Disk Usage shell: bash run: df -h || echo "Disk info skipped on Windows" - name: 📦 Upload Tree Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: tree-${{ matrix.os }} path: tree.txt # ================================== # 🚀 JOB 2 — BUILD, SECURITY & QA # ================================== build-secure: name: 🚀 Build, Security & QA runs-on: ubuntu-latest needs: audit steps: - name: 📥 Checkout Repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: 🟢 Setup Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: "18" - name: 🔢 Node & npm Versions run: | node -v npm -v - name: 📦 Install Dependencies (Safe) run: | if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install else echo "No package.json — skipping install" fi - name: 🛡️ npm Audit (Security Scan) run: | if [ -f package.json ]; then npm audit --audit-level=high || echo "⚠️ Vulnerabilities found" else echo "Skipping audit" fi - name: 🧪 Tests (if exist) run: | if npm run | grep -q test; then npm test else echo "No tests configured" fi - name: 🧹 Lint (if exist) run: | if npm run | grep -q lint; then npm run lint else echo "No lint configured" fi - name: 🏗️ Build (if exist) run: | if npm run | grep -q build; then npm run build else echo "No build configured" fi - name: 📄 Generate Build Report run: | echo "Build Report" > build-report.txt date >> build-report.txt echo "Node: $(node -v)" >> build-report.txt echo "NPM: $(npm -v)" >> build-report.txt du -sh . >> build-report.txt - name: 📦 Upload Build Report Artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: build-report path: build-report.txt - name: 🎉 Final Status run: echo "ULTRA DELUXE PIPELINE COMPLETE 🚀🔥"
